title: Marsden Electrical | NICEIC Electrician in Chester
desc: NICEIC approved electrician in Chester. Rewires, consumer units, EV charger installation, EICR reports and emergency callouts. Free written quotes.
sub: Domestic and commercial electrical work across Chester and Cheshire. Rewires, fuse boards, EV chargers and EICR reports — all certified, all guaranteed, all quoted in writing.
svc_h: Electrical work, certified and quoted up front.
svc_l: Every job leaves with the right certificate and a price agreed in writing beforehand.

services.title: EV charger installation

services.title: Fault finding & repairs

about_h: Certified work, plain English, no surprises.
about_p: Ryan Marsden has been an electrician for eighteen years, the last nine running Marsden Electrical. Every job leaves with the right certificate, notified to building control where it needs to be. We turn up when we say, we clean up after ourselves, and we will explain what we are doing without the jargon.

reviews.quote: Rewired our whole 1930s semi while we lived in it. Dust sheets everywhere, hoovered daily, and finished two days early. The certificate landed in my inbox the same afternoon.
reviews.name: Tom Ellison

reviews.quote: Needed an EICR at short notice for a rental. Booked Tuesday, done Thursday, report that evening. Letting agent said it was the clearest one they had seen.
reviews.name: Sandra Pike

reviews.quote: Fitted our EV charger and sorted a dodgy kitchen circuit he spotted while he was there. Charged me for half an hour extra, not a whole new job.
reviews.name: Dan Okafor

faq.a: Always. Every notifiable job is certified and registered with building control through NICEIC, and you get the paperwork by email the same week.

faq.q: Can you install an EV charger with a grant?
faq.a: We are an OZEV approved installer, so if you qualify for a grant we handle the application as part of the job.
Yes, 24/7 for genuine electrical emergencies — burning smells, sparking, total power loss. Ring rather than email.
